carla (acct mgr): Hi — customer on Private is unable to upload debug bundles. Collector creates archive but upload to presigned URL returns 403. They supplied request id req_6a9c2b and a short log excerpt. Can someone take a look?

alice (support): Sorry about that, thanks for the report. Can you paste the full collector log around the upload attempt and the presign URL request id? Also which collector version and OS?

carla (acct mgr): Collector v2.3.1 on EC2 (Amazon Linux 2). Log stripped to relevant lines: ```
[2026-03-12T14:02:11Z] collector: bundle.tar created /tmp/debug-20260312.tar
[2026-03-12T14:02:12Z] uploader: presign requested -> https://files.redwood-cust.example/presign/abc123
[2026-03-12T14:02:12Z] uploader: upload PUT -> https://files.redwood-cust.example/upload/abc123 -> status=403
[2026-03-12T14:02:12Z] uploader: response body: {"error":"Forbidden"}
```

alice (support): Thanks — 403 on PUT usually means the presign expired or nginx fronting the upload rejecting something. Two quick repro steps: 1) from the collector host, curl the presign URL with the same headers as the collector sent, 2) re-run collector with DEBUG env to capture full request headers. Can you run these and paste results?

carla (acct mgr): Ran curl like this: ```
curl -v -X PUT -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" --upload-file debug-20260312.tar "https://files.redwood-cust.example/upload/abc123?X-Amz-Signature=..."
```
Response shows 403 and nginx error: "client certificate required" in access log.

bob (sre): @alice @dmitri that log line is telling — the nginx in front of the upload endpoint is configured with ssl_verify_client on; presigned S3-style uploads shouldn't require client cert. Did the customer enable mutual TLS for the control plane but not for collector uploads?

dmitri (priv-deploy): I'm looking at the customer's ingress config now. They set ssl_verify_client optional on the control API and required on /upload locations by mistake: ```
location /upload/ {
  proxy_pass http://storage-backend;
  ssl_verify_client on; 
}
```
That would cause nginx to respond 403 when the collector doesn't present a client cert.

alice (support): Good catch. Carla — ask the customer if they intentionally set client cert requirement on /upload. Two options to reproduce and verify: 1) disable ssl_verify_client for /upload and retry, 2) supply a client cert to curl to see upload succeed. Example curl with client cert: ```
curl -v --key /path/client.key --cert /path/client.crt -X PUT --upload-file debug-20260312.tar "https://files.redwood-cust.example/upload/abc123?..."
```

carla (acct mgr): They confirmed it was accidental. They want a short repro we can give SOC to validate fixes. Also redaction: the customer said redaction sometimes fails when collector compresses before redaction. Any quick repro steps for confirming redaction runs?

bob (sre): For redaction, collector runs the redactor step before upload. Repro flow: 1) run collector with --no-upload to generate bundle locally, 2) inspect archive contents and run redactor manually: `collector redactor --input bundle.tar --rules /etc/redact/rules.yaml --dry-run` 3) check that redacted files are present. If redaction fails due to race with compression, try `COLLECTOR_REDACT_BEFORE_ARCHIVE=true`.

carla (acct mgr): Noted. I'll pass those steps. One more: can we provide a curl-based minimal repro that the SOC can run without the collector? They want to emulate what the collector does when uploading to presign so they can test nginx change.

dmitri (priv-deploy): Minimal curl repro for presigned PUT with headers the collector uses: ```
# presign_url is the full URL from presign request
curl -v -X PUT \
  -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \
  -H "Content-Encoding: identity" \
  --upload-file debug-20260312.tar \
  "$PRESIGN_URL"
```
If nginx requires mTLS, add `--key`/`--cert` as shown earlier.

alice (support): I'll add a short checklist to the ticket: 1) confirm nginx config on /upload doesn't require client cert, 2) run curl repro w/ and w/o cert, 3) if they must enforce mTLS, provide service cert to collectors or use SFTP fallback, 4) run collector with DEBUG and attach bundle + uploader logs.

carla (acct mgr): Customer patched nginx to `ssl_verify_client optional` on /upload and retried — upload succeeded. They also ran redaction check with `COLLECTOR_REDACT_BEFORE_ARCHIVE=true` and redaction completed.

bob (sre): Great. Recommend we add a note to Private deployment docs: presigned upload endpoints must not require client certs (or if they do, provide cert distribution steps). I'll open a docs PR.

alice (support): Closing the immediate support loop. @carla please attach the collector debug bundle (we asked for) to the ticket and mark resolved after customer confirms no further errors. :white_check_mark:

carla (acct mgr): thanks everyone :bow:
